set system host-name PE1.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

set protocols rstp interface all.explanation: Enables RSTP protocols on all interfaces.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: Interface range, call indicates all interfaces.

mode rapid-pvst.explanation: Configure the RSTP protocol with a fast PVST model for all interfaces.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.explanation: RSTP mode, Rapid-pvst means fast PVST mode.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: 接口名称，all表示所有接口。

parameters.name: method
parameters.explanation: 路径成本计算方法，例如long。
